final_handoff.cleanup_scope: This disposable arena item entities tagged before removal; unique test diamonds also removed by nonce tag.

limits: Recent observed player death locations, not actual item tracking or every manual attack/use, are protected.
An actual player death and real diamond item were required; entity removal or totem events were not substituted.
TTL uses conservative before26s/after31s witnesses around the recorded kill interval, not exact incoming-packet timing.
The live active cancellation case isolates an owned placed crystal and subsequent death/restore; the sub-tick deferred queue race is not independently isolated.
Projectile Event3 bytes have separate compiled protocol coverage; the live case observes real throws/impact/removal, not raw incoming bytes.
Historical failures are retained and classified as fixture/runner failures; there was no native source change between these R10 attempts.
The native checkbox bypass intervention was exercised on Anchor Macro; the other owners have live positive/refusal controls, not four separate live checkbox-bypass tests.
Guard blocked_checks counts evaluations, not packets, clicks or unique prevented explosions.
Native screenshots are copied unchanged; numerical claims use recorded native and authoritative Java facts.
